headline.title: Pre-season: cold nights ahead.
headline.text: 12 of the 31 resorts close to opening get nights cold enough to make snow, mostly in White Mountains and Western Maine. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

BTV.excerpt:
Increased fire weather concerns through this weekend.
Mostly dry and seasonable conditions continue through the weekend.
A weak cool front early next week will slow a warming trend during another extended quiet weather period.

ALY.excerpt:
) Elevated risk for fire spread Friday for areas within and immediately adjacent to the Hudson River Valley, western MA and NW CT due to dry fuels combined with gusty winds and low RH.
) Dry weather expected for this weekend through early next week, with next chance for widespread rainfall not until Thursday or Friday.

GYX.excerpt: High pressure continues to dominate the weather into next week. Expect mainly dry conditions and no significant weather impacts.

BUF.excerpt:
) Showers tonight, cooler and dry on Friday in the wake of the cold front.
) Another extended period of dry weather and above average temperatures this weekend through early next week.

PHI.excerpt: Generally tranquil weather is expected to prevail through at least the beginning of next week.

CTP.excerpt:
) Fire weather concerns Friday
) Dry and mild conditions to start November

RLX.excerpt: ) Dry conditions and above normal temperatures dominate through much of the weekend. The chance for showers returns to the forecast for some locations late Sunday into early next week, with a better chance for rainfall towards mid next week.

writeups.name: Vermont
writeups.title: Dry, with cold nights.
paras: Next two days: summit temperatures from {{t:21}} to {{t:51}}, with up to {{s:0.5}} of snow.
Killington usually opens first here, around Nov 8. Jay Peak gets the most hours cold enough to make snow this week (about 21).
NWS Burlington forecasters, Thursday 7:41 PM: "Increased fire weather concerns through this weekend."
writeups.outlook: Days 8 to 14: NOAA's outlook leans slightly warmer than normal and slightly wetter than normal. Wet and mild often means rain below the summits.

insights.text: Cold enough to make snow Saturday evening to early Sunday: about 11 hours at or below {{t:26}} at mid-mountain, counting humidity. One more cold stretch follows this week. Whether the guns run is up to the resort.
Typically opens around Nov 27, 28 days out.
